title: Machine nine started on its own 🧺
style_prompt: photorealistic 35mm film photograph, cold green fluorescent light, eerie and calm, empty 24-hour laundromat at night, no people, no faces, no text, no numbers, no logos
hook_text: At 1:33 a.m. washing machine nine started on its own.

scenes.narration: At 1:33 a.m. washing machine nine started on its own.

shots.prompt: wide shot of an empty self-service laundromat at night, a long row of steel washing machines, one machine glowing warm from inside, wet tile floor

scenes.narration: I run the night shift at a self-service laundromat. Twenty machines. No customers after midnight.

shots.prompt: interior of an empty laundromat at night with a folding table and a plastic basket, cold green fluorescent light, dark foggy window

scenes.narration: Machine nine was empty. I had checked it myself. The drum was turning anyway. Slowly. Dark water inside.

shots.prompt: close view of a washing machine round glass door with dark water slowly swirling inside, no clothes, green fluorescent reflection

scenes.narration: I pressed the stop button. It did not stop. The door lock clicked shut. From the inside.

shots.prompt: close view of a washing machine control panel with a glowing orange light and a steel door handle, dark laundromat behind

scenes.narration: Then the machine beside it started. And the one after that. One by one. All down the row.

shots.prompt: long row of washing machines in an empty laundromat at night, every machine door glowing warm orange, wet reflections on the floor

scenes.narration: I looked at the glass. Something pale pressed against it. Folded. Like clothes. Folded very neatly.

shots.prompt: close view of a washing machine glass door with a pale folded cloth pressed against the inside of the glass, dark water around it

scenes.narration: The cycle ended. Every door unlocked at once. And on the floor in front of me lay a pile of folded clothes. My size. My jacket on top.

shots.prompt: neat pile of folded clothes on a wet tile floor under a flickering fluorescent light, a dark jacket folded on top, empty laundromat at night

scenes.narration: I never put them in. The tag in the collar was handwritten. It said, wash complete. Owner returning.

shots.prompt: close view of the collar of a dark jacket with a small blank paper tag, cold green light, tile floor

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you wait for the owner, or lock up?

shots.prompt: wide shot of an empty self-service laundromat at night, a long row of steel washing machines, one machine glowing warm from inside, wet tile floor
